title: Advocating for a Colleague's Promotion
paragraphs: Noticing that a talented but soft-spoken colleague was consistently overlooked for promotions in favor of more self-promoting employees with comparatively weaker performance, Salsabila decided to advocate for her colleague directly with senior management.

This advocacy required Salsabila to spend considerable personal effort documenting her colleague's specific contributions, since the colleague herself remained reluctant to draw attention to her own achievements in the way more assertive employees did.

Some colleagues privately suggested that Salsabila's efforts might be seen as overstepping normal boundaries, since advocating so directly for another employee's promotion was not a typical or expected practice within their company culture.

When her colleague was eventually promoted, partly due to the concrete evidence Salsabila had compiled, both women recognized that quiet excellence sometimes required an advocate willing to make it visible to those making decisions.
